candidate_ideas.statement: Under a proved nonemptiness or dominance hypothesis for the reduced-support open on each component, pencil recovery should imply image dimension dim(B)+2 and codimension 19-dim(B) in M_{6,6}.
A discriminant analysis inside each P^2 fibre may establish the existence of a reduced member of |L| even though L is not uniformly base-point-free.
The relative determinantal scheme may coincide with the Abel-Jacobi incidence under explicit disjoint-section and cohomology-and-base-change hypotheses, via a direct comparison of Fitting ideals.

Functorial reconstruction of gamma as a morphism to the P^1-bundle associated with p_*(omega(-Gamma)) may extend geometric-point injectivity and stabilizer equality to full faithfulness on all base schemes.
A Hurwitz-stratified analysis may show that every relevant balanced component has dimension 15 after accounting for nonsimple ramification and special curve loci.
Degree-four covers factoring through positive-genus intermediate curves should be analyzed separately from hyperelliptic-composed covers when classifying balanced components.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004, Lemma 10.6, gives deg(W_f|_C)=2(2g-2+8)-4f=4g+12-4f using gamma^*O(-f).
established_facts.statement: With W_f := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-f))|_C, one has deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f; the negative sign is essential.

established_facts.evidence: The weak normalization with a residual pullback A has degree equation 10+8+4 deg(A)=18, hence deg(A)=0; Pic(P^1)=Z makes A trivial. Substitution into W_f gives the three displayed identities.
established_facts.statement: The normalization is O_P(1)|_C isomorphic to omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2); consequently W_4=omega_C^2, W_5=omega_C^2(-D), and L:=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}=omega_C(-D).

established_facts.evidence: Direct substitution gives 4*6+12-4*4=20 and 4*6+12-4*5=16; subtracting deg(omega_C)=10 gives deg(L)=6.
established_facts.statement: For g=6, deg(W_4)=20, deg(W_5)=16, and deg(L)=6.

established_facts.evidence: Riemann-Roch gives chi(L)=6-6+1=1, so h^0(L)-1=h^1(L); Serre duality gives h^1(L)=h^0(omega_C tensor L^{-1})=h^0(O_C(D)).

The pulled-back pencil supplies two sections and Clifford gives h^0(D)<=3. Equality forces the hyperelliptic equality case. Conversely, if a hyperelliptic curve had h^0(D)=2, the map (h,gamma) to P^1 times P^1 would either force factorization through h or be birational onto a bidegree-(4,2) curve of arithmetic genus 3, contradicting genus 6.
established_facts.statement: For every degree-four cover of a genus-six curve, h^0(O_C(D)) belongs to {2,3}; it equals 3 exactly in the hyperelliptic-composed case, where D is linearly equivalent to twice the hyperelliptic class.

established_facts.evidence: The factorization pushforward gives gamma_*O_C=O direct-sum O(-1) direct-sum O(-4)^2. After twisting the conic-bundle sequence by O(-6), h^0(Sym^2E(-6))=9 and the target has 7 sections, so h^0(F(-6))>=2; balanced F would give h^0(F(-6))=0.
established_facts.statement: A hyperelliptic genus-six degree-four cover has Tschirnhausen bundle E=O(1) direct-sum O(4) direct-sum O(4) and cannot have balanced relations bundle F=O(4) direct-sum O(5).

established_facts.evidence: Balancedness excludes the hyperelliptic case, so the dichotomy gives h^0(D)=2; the Riemann-Roch and Serre-duality identities then give h^1(L)=2 and h^0(L)=3.
established_facts.statement: On the balanced locus, h^0(O_C(D))=2, h^0(L)=3, and h^1(L)=2 without fibrewise jumping.

established_facts.evidence: The W_4 term has deg(W_4(-Gamma))=14>10, so its evaluation cokernel vanishes. The W_5 term has degree 10 after subtracting Gamma; Serre duality identifies its cokernel with sections of a degree-zero line bundle, which is one-dimensional exactly when that bundle is trivial. The filtered snake lemma transfers this cokernel to the full evaluation.
established_facts.statement: For a balanced pair and an effective degree-six divisor Gamma, the fibrewise CE evaluation has corank at most one; its cokernel is one-dimensional exactly when O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L and is zero otherwise.

established_facts.evidence: The fibre dimensions h^0(L)=3 and h^1(L)=2 are constant; Grauert gives local freeness and base change. The divisor functor defining the Abel-Jacobi fibre agrees with P(p_*L), and projectivization is unchanged by a line-bundle twist from the base.
established_facts.statement: Over a reduced locally Noetherian base carrying a balanced family, p_*L is locally free of rank 3, R^1p_*L is locally free of rank 2, and the full relative Abel-Jacobi incidence is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle, smooth and proper of pure relative dimension 2.

established_facts.evidence: The identity O_C(Gamma)=omega_C(-D) gives omega_C(-Gamma)=O_C(D), whose space of sections has dimension 2 and contains the pulled-back gamma-pencil. Completeness gives recovery; surjectivity of gamma gives uniqueness of the target automorphism.
established_facts.statement: If O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L on a balanced pair, then |omega_C(-Gamma)| is the complete base-point-free pencil defining gamma; gamma is recovered up to PGL_2, and Aut(C,gamma,Gamma) is isomorphic to Aut(C,Gamma).

established_facts.evidence: The expected codimension is (11-5)(6-5)=6 inside relative Sym^6 of dimension 6. The actual fibre is P^2, and h^1(L)=2.
established_facts.statement: The generic determinantal expectation for the corank-one locus of the 11-to-6 evaluation is relative dimension 0, whereas the actual Abel-Jacobi fibre has dimension 2; the excess equals h^1(L)=2.

established_facts.evidence: The base-point condition is h^0(L(-p))=h^0(L)=3. Serre duality and Riemann-Roch for the degree-five bundle O_C(D+p), whose Euler characteristic is zero, convert this to h^0(O_C(D+p))=3. For the plane-quintic example, h^0(H-p)=2 and h^0(H+p)=3=h^0(H).
established_facts.statement: When h^0(L)=3, a point p is a base point of |L| exactly when h^0(O_C(D+p))=3; for a smooth plane quintic with canonical class 2H and D=H-p, one has L=H+p and p is a base point.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The reduced-support locus is only an open subset of the projective bundle and may be empty or fail to dominate a component of B. Injectivity controls fibres where the open exists but does not prove nonemptiness or dominance.
invalid_steps.statement: The reduced-support open has image dimension dim(B)+2 merely because the full Abel-Jacobi incidence is a P^2-bundle and the classifying map is injective on geometric points.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The filtered relative argument uses six disjoint sections and cohomology-and-base-change hypotheses. Fibrewise rank behavior does not determine nilpotent or Fitting scheme structure for a general relative divisor.
invalid_steps.statement: The relative identities Fit_0(coker(phi))=I_12(phi)=I_6(phi_5) hold over any base carrying an arbitrary relative degree-six divisor.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The h^0(D)=3 case detects composition through the genus-zero hyperelliptic map. Factorizations through degree-two maps to intermediate curves of positive genus are not excluded by this dichotomy and can retain h^0(D)=2.
invalid_steps.statement: Constancy of h^0(omega_C(-D)) on the balanced locus is equivalent to excluding every non-primitive degree-four pencil.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Total ramification degree equals the number of distinct branch points only for simple ramification. Collisions and higher ramification change the branch-point count and can alter component dimensions.
invalid_steps.statement: The Riemann-Hurwitz total ramification degree 18 implies that the balanced degree-four cover space has dimension 18-3=15 without further hypotheses.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Riemann-Roch guarantees only a nonzero section. Its divisor may have repeated support, and every member of the linear system may contain a non-reduced fixed part.
invalid_steps.statement: The equality chi(L)=1 guarantees a reduced effective divisor in |L| and hence a nonempty ordered six-point incidence.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Balancedness supplies a relative Harder-Narasimhan filtration, not a global splitting. The relevant extension class need not vanish over the base.
invalid_steps.statement: Fibrewise balancedness gives a global splitting W=W_4 direct-sum W_5 over an arbitrary family, permitting block-diagonal minor factorization.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Failure to attain the generic determinantal codimension does not preclude a regular sequence of the actual codimension. A local-complete-intersection conclusion requires depth or conormal calculations.
invalid_steps.statement: Expected determinantal codimension 6 versus actual codimension 4 implies that the rank-drop locus is nowhere a local complete intersection.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The field of definition of deck-group representations does not control the Hodge type of cohomology with the associated geometric monodromy local systems.
invalid_steps.statement: A finite etale S_6-cover contributes only Tate cohomology because every rational irreducible representation of S_6 is defined over Q.

reusable_computations.statement: For g=6 and n=6, d=3g-3+n=21 and 2d-16=26.
Using deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f at g=6 gives deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_4)=20.
For a degree-six divisor Gamma, 4f+n-2g-14 equals -4 for f=4 and 0 for f=5.
For L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, deg(L)=6 and chi(L)=deg(L)-g+1=1.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: A scheme-theoretic comparison of the relative CE Fitting ideal with the Abel-Jacobi incidence ideal under precisely stated disjoint-section and base-change hypotheses.
Existence of a reduced member of |omega_C(-D)|, or dominance of the reduced-support open, on every balanced component under consideration.
The dimension of every balanced tetragonal base component, including nonsimple ramification and exclusion or control of larger components over special curve loci.
Exhaustive analysis of unbalanced splitting types, bielliptic, plane-quintic, trigonal-adjacent, and other special loci, together with closure and component behavior.
A complete source moduli functor and full-faithfulness proof on all base schemes for reconstruction of the tetragonal pencil.
Cohomology-and-base-change and projective-bundle statements over non-reduced locally Noetherian bases.
Local structure of the image in M_{6,6}, including closedness, immersion behavior, depth, conormal modules, regular embeddings, and any valid Gysin formalism.
Tate support for the relevant geometric strata and an assembly argument identifying the exact weight-26 ordinary cohomology, equivalently the weight-minus-16 Borel-Moore target.
